meta.description: Stromboli v1 — agentic coding-triage system. Notion-captured, spec'd tasks dispatch a self-hosted Python worker that builds via the Ralph loop in an isolated git worktree, runs CI, opens a PR, and writes results back to Notion.

items.description: Initialise the Python project with uv (pyproject.toml + lockfile) and a Settings object that loads NOTION_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY, LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY, LANGFUSE_HOST, TUNNEL_PUBLIC_URL, WORKSPACE_ROOT, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, DISPATCH_SHARED_SECRET from env/.env; missing required vars fail fast naming the key; .env.example documents all vars and .env is gitignored. Tests pass; typecheck and ruff lint pass.

Build a typed Notion task client: get_task(page_id) exposing Task name/Project/Status/Spec/Assigned to/Ready/Needs review/PR/Cost/Tokens; get_project_repo() resolving owner/repo; update_task() writing Status/PR/Cost/Tokens; append_task_body() appending markdown; Status writes map to the exact existing labels (To do/Working on/Review/Complete) with no API-created options. Unit tests assert parsed field values and repo resolution against a mocked Notion response. Tests pass; typecheck and lint pass.

Create a FastAPI app with POST /stromboli/dispatch that accepts a JSON body containing the task page ID, requires a shared-secret header (401 if missing/invalid), returns 202 immediately and processes the build asynchronously; add GET /healthz returning 200; document the Cloudflare Tunnel mapping and the Notion 'Ready checked' automation trigger contract in README. Unit tests: invalid secret -> 401, valid request -> 202. Tests pass; typecheck and lint pass.

Implement the dispatch guard and idempotent claim: proceed only if Ready==true AND Assigned to==Agent AND Status==To do, else log reason and exit; on valid claim set Status=Working on before any build; treat already-claimed Working on/Review/Complete as a no-op; a single in-process lock enforces one build at a time (serial worker), concurrent dispatches queue or are rejected with a logged reason. Unit tests cover guard pass, each guard-fail branch, and double-dispatch idempotency. Tests pass; typecheck and lint pass.

Prepare an isolated git worktree per task: resolve owner/repo from Project.Repo, ensure a local clone under WORKSPACE_ROOT and fetch latest main, create a fresh worktree on a deterministically-named branch (e.g. stromboli/<task-id>-<slug>), and remove/clean up the worktree on completion or failure. Unit/integration tests verify branch-name derivation and cleanup on error. Tests pass; typecheck and lint pass.

Convert the task Spec into a Ralph prd.json ({meta, items}) written into the worktree: set meta.maxAttempts, map each acceptance criterion to an item with passes:false/attempts:0/blocked:false, and set meta.branchName to match the US-005 worktree branch. Unit test asserts N acceptance criteria produce N well-formed items. Tests pass; typecheck and lint pass.

Run the Ralph loop in the worktree: invoke claude -p iterations with the repo's CLAUDE.md until all items pass or are blocked or a ceiling is hit, capturing per-iteration JSON output; stop on the completion signal <promise>COMPLETE</promise> or when no eligible item remains; retain progress.txt and prd.json as run artifacts. Integration test with a stubbed CC invocation verifies termination on the completion signal and on the ceiling. Tests pass; typecheck and lint pass.

Add a circuit breaker with configurable max-iterations and max-cost (USD) ceilings per task: on trip, stop the loop, set Status=Review, append a note explaining the trip to the task body, and log/trace the reason in Langfuse. Unit test: simulated cost over the ceiling trips the breaker and routes to Review (assert resulting status and note). Tests pass; typecheck and lint pass.

Add a reusable GitHub Actions workflow that runs on pull_request to install deps and run tests, lint, and type checks, failing the check when any fail; wire it into the target repo so it runs on the worker's branch; document in README how a new target repo opts in. CodeQL and the eval suite are explicitly deferred. Workflow YAML validates; typecheck and lint pass.

After a successful loop, commit the worktree changes, push the branch, open a PR against main with a title/body derived from the task and spec, and write the PR URL to the task PR field; if no changes were produced, route to Review with an explanatory note instead of opening an empty PR. Unit test verifies PR title/body derivation and the empty-diff branch. Tests pass; typecheck and lint pass.

Implement integration routing per the autonomy table: if Needs review==true set Status=Review; if Needs review==false set Status=Complete after the PR is opened (human merges in v1, no auto-merge); Assigned to==Human tasks are never picked up or modified. Unit test covers all three routing branches. Tests pass; typecheck and lint pass.

Write the worker outcome back to Notion: on completion (success, blocked, or breaker trip) append a feedback summary to the task body (work done, blockers and why, PR link) and set the final Status from US-011; make write-back resilient so a Notion write failure is retried and logged without crashing the worker. Unit test asserts the summary includes blocked-item reasons when present. Tests pass; typecheck and lint pass.

Add Langfuse observability: each task build is a trace and each Ralph iteration is a span; record cost and token usage parsed from CC output on the trace; tag circuit-breaker trips and failures. Writing Cost/Tokens back to Notion is deferred to phase 2. Tests pass; typecheck and lint pass.
